steps: Typed CO-UKR-RUTH1 under Play a seed
Read the declassified table of what really happened
Started a new game from the end screen
scenarios.notes: Played months 3 onward mostly by Accept all recommended then Execute, so I did not read most crises. Reached the sealed record, 620, B, 2 stars.

steps: Played the Flashpoint only, not a full term

friction.expected: One tap opens the code box
friction.happened: First tap on the button did nothing visible; second tap opened a small box below. Box is easy to miss

friction.expected: Tapping a card is obviously choosing it
friction.happened: No clear selected state after tapping Only by referendum; side panel still said cabinet pick not accepted. I just pressed Execute and hoped

friction.where: Month 1, floating label over card 3 (Best trade-off)
friction.happened: Green label overlapped and was cut off by the crisis card above
Warning that my cabinet pick works against my mission, and the mission tip box covering the headline

friction.expected: Recommended panel clear of the political capital header
friction.happened: Panel overlaps the Political capital heading, content clipped
Month 6 of 12 and the this-month hint are truncated (month 6 o...)

friction.expected: Read the crisis before accepting its recommended answer
friction.happened: The Review recommended list shows only a one-line crisis name (Hostages in Belarus, Send in special forces); I accepted without seeing the story. It then failed badly (stability 51 to 35)

friction.expected: Know what the many round symbols mean
friction.happened: Dozens of unlabeled icons on the map; I did not know which were pressable or what they meant
Fortress belt, oblast, Kramatorsk, Belarus hostage story: I know Ukraine well, so fine, but the names badge (2 names) was helpful and I would use it for Belarus
Coalition of the willing locked in (UK relations 93+), Presidency Score, seal, Statesman: score vocabulary and numbers like 93+ were not explained as a game concept
Month 9 shows The comeback in went well and Coalition of the willing, Accept it publicly in went badly; labels like Accept it publicly were unclear

friction.expected: Tapping The verdict shows the verdict
friction.happened: My tap on The verdict showed How you were seen instead; I never properly saw the verdict screen. It may have auto-passed
Four options: Replay same opening, New world, Compare runs (greyed), New game. New world and New game sound the same
Excellent, but Russia 1182k estimate vs 880k and 100% nuclear program are military jargon I would not know

bugs.title: Recommended panel overlaps Political capital heading in desk right rail
steps: On month 2 look at right rail at 1024x768
bugs.actual: Panel overlaps and clips the capital block

bugs.title: Floating Best trade-off label clipped by crisis card
Reveal sidebar The verdict tap lands on a different stage
steps: At end The count, step through, tap The verdict in sidebar from the Ranking stage

bugs.title: Header truncates month and goal hint on tablet

suggestions.what: Show the crisis text and a one-line why next to Accept answer in the recommended list and in Map mode
suggestions.goal_served: R1 understand what I am deciding

suggestions.what: Plain selected state (tick, thick border) on a tapped answer card
One end-screen button called Play again, with Replay same opening as a smaller option
Label the map icons or give a legend on tap

delight: Seed code worked first time and the Some help question suited me
What really happened table with sources next to my game (devloop/instances/world-conflict/runs/iter-03/shots/ruth-tablet/048-truth2.png)
Result cards with a quote from the street and Step achieved stamp (devloop/instances/world-conflict/runs/iter-03/shots/ruth-tablet/013-m2c.png)

fun.reason: Absorbing when I read; rewarding ending. Accept all made later months feel automatic.

clarity.reason: Month loop clear after month 2, but selecting an answer and the right rail were unclear.

visual.reason: Handsome art and paper; some overlaps on tablet.

feels_like_a_game.reason: Feels like a briefing exercise; I never felt a game for non-gamers risk.

agency.reason: Never blocked, but accepted Belarus rescue unseen and it failed.

realism.reason: Real names and leaders, real-world comparison at the end; war ending in month 8 felt too neat.

replay.reason: Would try Middle East; ending buttons are a bit confusing.

recommend.reason: I would tell a friend who follows the news; the truth table is the best part.

verbatim: I liked reading what really happened next to my game. I did not like pressing Execute without knowing whether my choice had been taken.
